remarks: This is home is exactly where the New Canaan market is right now. Tucked down a private lane, this is the kind of home buyers are looking for-clean, updated, and completely move-in ready.  254 White Oak Shade has just been refreshed with new paint, refinished floors, and thoughtful staging that makes the entire home feel light, bright, and easy. The living spaces are filled with natural light, and the layout works for both everyday living and entertaining without trying too hard.  It's a classic New Canaan home with the right updates already done-so you're not walking into a project. The setting is what makes this one stand out. Quiet, private, and surrounded by greenery, yet just minutes to town, the train, and an easy commute. You have quick access to Norwalk for everyday convenience-Costco and Target runs-while still living in New Canaan with top-tier schools and the charm of a true village.  Homes like this-updated, well-located, and ready to go-make this a choice you will not want to miss. Deadline for offers is Monday 5/4 @ 5pm
